definitions.summary: 2x2 area within 12; UTF >= each target Reflex: 3d8 chosen physical type and attack -2 until next turn; FP gives half damage on misses.

resourceOptions.summary: On a Reflex miss, target takes half of the rolled 3d8 without the attack penalty.

definitions.summary: 2x2 area; UTF vs each Fortitude: hit 4d6 fire and ignite, miss half damage without ignition; ignite uses UTF total as ongoing fire attack bonus.

resourceOptions.summary: Move one target hit by Combustion down one CT step.
requirements: Target must have been hit, not merely damaged by the miss-half effect

definitions.summary: Touch a living other creature, heal character level x1/x2/x3/x4 at DC 15/20/25/30; each use costs -1 persistent CT and +1 Dark Side Point.

dcTiers.summary: Heal 1 x caster character level HP
Heal 2 x caster character level HP
Heal 3 x caster character level HP
Heal 4 x caster character level HP

requirements: A dead creature is not a valid base Dark Transfer target; Improved Dark Transfer supplies the distinct exception.
Persistent CT cost and Dark Side Point gain occur each use, not conditional on a successful healing tier.

resourceOptions.summary: Avoid the persistent -1 condition step, but still gain 1 Dark Side Point.

rulesNotes: Persistent cost applies even when no DC tier succeeded; base onSuccess is also modeled as an on-activation cost in powerRules and test manifest.

definitions.summary: One unattended object within 12/LOS takes 4d6/6d6/8d6/10d6 at DC 20/25/30/35; FP adds 2d6.
Swift action or reaction, ally within 12/LOS substitutes caster UTF total for ONE attack/skill/opposed roll or selected defense before start of caster next turn.

resourceOptions.summary: Extend substitution availability until the end of your next turn.

rulesNotes: No fixed DC or hostile-defense gate. Receiving ally chooses one published roll/defense mode; activation UTF total is the value.

definitions.summary: All adjacent enemies, UTF vs each Reflex; hit 3d6 Force and -1 CT, miss half Force damage without CT; maintained as standard if unmoved.

resourceOptions.summary: Increase base Lightning Burst damage by +2d6; miss still takes half adjusted damage.

rulesNotes: Source: maintain as standard action provided caster has not moved since activating; each maintenance activation rolls UTF anew against each currently adjacent enemy.

definitions.summary: Reaction to a just-rolled enemy attack within 12/LOS; UTF >= attacker Will applies -5 to the attack; if it misses, optional reroll against another creature adjacent to attacker at -5.

resourceOptions.summary: Apply -5 to all of that enemy’s attacks until start of its next turn.

adjudication: The phrase “another creature adjacent to it” refers to the original attacker (the power’s defined target), not the creature originally attacked.

definitions.summary: Against one enemy LOS, DC 15/20/25 grants +1/+2/+3 insight to attacks against that enemy and Defenses vs its attacks/effects through end of caster next turn.

dcTiers.summary: +1 insight to attacks vs selected foe and defenses vs its effects
+2 insight to attacks vs selected foe and defenses vs its effects
+3 insight to attacks vs selected foe and defenses vs its effects

resourceOptions.summary: Affect one additional enemy within line of sight using the same tier.

definitions.summary: Swift, one adjacent enemy: UTF >= Fortitude deals 2d6 Force damage and pushes 1 square without AoO; FP targets all adjacent enemies.

resourceOptions.summary: Compare UTF against all adjacent enemies’ Fortitude Defenses and apply base hit effects individually.

rulesNotes: Forced displacement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

definitions.summary: Replace Vital Transfer healing with UTF vs active poison DC, detoxifying as Treat Injury on success; no ordinary healing.

requirements: Source power activation otherwise valid; no independent acquisition requirement for knowing Vital Transfer unless printed in source.

rulesNotes: The poison has its own external DC; this is not a new universal DC tier.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: Replace Vital Transfer healing with UTF vs active poison DC, detoxifying as Treat Injury on success; no ordinary healing.

definitions.summary: Spend FP on Ballistakinesis to increase 2x2 area to 3x3.
adjudication: Base Ballistakinesis FP gives half damage on miss; this technique spends an FP to enlarge. Do not silently combine both alternatives from one spend.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: Spend FP on Ballistakinesis to increase 2x2 area to 3x3.

definitions.summary: Spend FP, DC 25 UTF, revive creature deceased since end of last turn: target becomes unconscious, not dead, and gets no HP healing.

resourceOptions.summary: Replace normal Dark Transfer healing with DC 25 revive.

rulesNotes: Other use-cost consequences are still governed by Dark Transfer source unless a published exception says otherwise.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: Spend FP, DC 25 UTF, revive creature deceased since end of last turn: target becomes unconscious, not dead, and gets no HP healing.

definitions.summary: On Detonate, enemies within 2 squares of the object suffer HALF damage actually sustained by object if UTF >= each Reflex; area attack.
rulesNotes: No incidental enemy damage on failed per-enemy Reflex comparison; each is separately checked.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: On Detonate, enemies within 2 squares of the object suffer HALF damage actually sustained by object if UTF >= each Reflex; area attack.

definitions.summary: Spend FP during Enlighten to include one additional ally.

resourceOptions.summary: Second ally receives its own legal Enlighten option.

rulesNotes: Additional ally is separate from original target, must satisfy ability range and LOS.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: Spend FP during Enlighten to include one additional ally.

definitions.summary: On Lightning Burst, compare UTF to each target’s Reflex AND Fortitude; if both met, also push 1 square and prone.
rulesNotes: Failing Fortitude does NOT cancel existing Lightning Burst Reflex damage/CT; it only cancels this technique’s extra push/prone.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: On Lightning Burst, compare UTF to each target’s Reflex AND Fortitude; if both met, also push 1 square and prone.

definitions.summary: Spend FP during Obscure to gain +5 Force bonus on its Use the Force check.

resourceOptions.summary: Add +5 Force bonus to Obscure’s triggering UTF check.

rulesNotes: This is distinct from the base Obscure FP option that extends attack penalties through next turn.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: Spend FP during Obscure to gain +5 Force bonus on its Use the Force check.

definitions.summary: When using Force Shield, spend FP to include adjacent allies; alternatively spend DP to shield occupied vehicle of any size; non-stacking SR.

resourceOptions.summary: Shield self plus all adjacent allies, using one shared power activation and source-defined SR.
Protect occupied vehicle, regardless of size; existing vehicle SR and granted Force Shield SR do not stack.

rulesNotes: Do NOT duplicate Legacy Force Shield: the known originating definition is FUCG p86 and is reprinted Legacy p54.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: When using Force Shield, spend FP to include adjacent allies; alternatively spend DP to shield occupied vehicle of any size; non-stacking SR.

definitions.summary: Spend FP to push a successful Stagger target 2 squares instead of 1.

resourceOptions.summary: Replace one-square base push with two squares; does not add one plus two.

adjudication: The base Stagger FP affects all adjacent enemies; this FP improves push. Two competing FP uses are not automatically merged.

techniqueRules.sourceBenefit: Spend FP to push a successful Stagger target 2 squares instead of 1.

unresolvedSourceInterpretations.issue: Potential FP stacking: base Ballistakinesis half-on-miss versus Improved Ballistakinesis area-expansion. No text authorizes both from one FP; encode distinct choices until adjudicated.
Competing base/technique FP modes for Obscure, Stagger, and Force Shield. Do not silently combine, double-charge, or treat a single point as paying multiple enhancements.
Combustion ongoing fire uses initial UTF check TOTAL as fire attack bonus; confirm how fire attacks are scheduled/resolved by shared Core fire service without a duplicate fire subsystem.

Dark Transfer persistent condition cost applies to each use, including a failed healing check. Treatment alongside revival variant and Dark Preservation must respect explicit source costs and resource expenditure timing.
Legacy uses `equal or exceeds` for ability hit checks, and Ballistakinesis FP says targets you `fail to exceed`: treat equality as hit based on complete rule, not as half-damage miss.
Detonate printed damage type unspecified. Improved Detonate gives nearby targets slashing damage based on actual object damage; object hardness/DR and half rounding owned by shared DamageSystem.
Force Shield is a Legacy reprint of FUCG original, not a second learnable definition; repeated text read matches known origin, but verify formal published errata.
Official Legacy Era-specific errata was not independently authenticated in this pass. Printed pages 53–56 remain authority pending an official source.
Enlighten defense substitution scope: one chosen defense until next turn versus consumed one roll. Store source-specific distinction and do not invent repeated or unrestricted substitution.

Original Obscure “another creature adjacent to it” uses “target” for attacking enemy. Explicitly resolve adjacent-to-attacker for implementation; retain review if contradictory official clarification found.

reprints.notes: Legacy p54 repeats FUCG p86 Force Shield; Improved Force Shield belongs to Legacy as its own technique.
